title: The Trail of the Sepik Basin
author: Juniper Blackwood
blurb: Cyrus Sterling, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent three years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
